heading: Today
text: Areas of low clouds and fog, then partly sunny.  More afternoon clouds, with a few localized showers, mainly in or near the mountains from Rt. 2 north.  Highs ranging through the 70s.  Light winds freshening from the northwest 5 to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any evening showers ending.  Periods of clouds through the north and mountains, partly cloudy in southern valleys.  Lows in the 50s.  Winds north near 10 mph, diminishing to light outside the Champlain Valley.

heading: Saturday
text: Some low clouds and fog, then periods of sun.  Localized afternoon showers, more likely from the Green Mountains east.  Highs in the 60s to near 70 north, low to mid 70s south.  Light winds, mainly north up to 10 mph.
